capabilities: Track debts and receivables per person
Calculate remaining and net balances automatically
Store records as editable Markdown notes
disambiguation: Not a general accounting or budgeting app; it tracks debts and receivables between individuals, not business finances.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README is bilingual (English and Persian) and lists recent version changelogs (2.0.10 through 2.0.13).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track money owed between people, so users keep personal financial records in separate applications or spreadsheets.
summary: Personal debts and receivables tracker that records people, transactions, and partial payments as Markdown notes, with automatic balance calculation.
